name: img-uploader
title: img Uploader
description: Upload images to your configured img host — screenshot, clipboard, or file. Supports Cloudflare R2, S3, OSS, GitHub, and HTTP endpoints.
author: liyown

commands.name: upload-screenshot
commands.title: Upload Screenshot
commands.subtitle: img
commands.description: Capture a screenshot (full screen or region) and upload it. The Markdown link is copied to clipboard.

commands.name: upload-clipboard
commands.title: Upload Clipboard Image
commands.subtitle: img
commands.description: Upload the image currently on the clipboard. The result is copied back.

commands.name: upload-file
commands.title: Upload Image File
commands.subtitle: img
commands.description: Pick one or more image files to upload.

preferences.name: imgPath
preferences.title: img executable
preferences.description: Path to the img binary (must be in PATH or provide absolute path)

preferences.name: outputFormat
preferences.title: Output format
preferences.description: Format of the link copied to clipboard after upload

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: Provider override
preferences.description: Override the default img provider (leave empty to use default)
